name: Strawberry Shortcake
source:
The game is a short but sweet history about being stood up by a date and finding someone with who you can talk for a while.

[From [url=https://zejbo32.itch.io/strawberry-shortcake]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個簡短卻甜蜜的故事：約會被放了鴿子，卻遇見一個可以聊上一會兒的人。

[摘自[url=https://zejbo32.itch.io/strawberry-shortcake]Itch.io[/url]]
